properties.statement: Wrote a script over the usage ledger to get per-tool COST — median and max ms per tool, total time share, the slowest single calls, a per-call timeline across the day, and which calls overlapped in time (which is how the duplicate same-second pairs were found). The ledger already stores `ms` on every call; usage_report renders counts, refusals and never-called, but none of the durations it holds. The whole prioritisation of the optimisation campaign came from that hand-rolled read.
